title: New Tab extension: a one-line page and the clock sample, picked in tabs.newTabApp, drawn in new tabs; then a broken one shows cmux's own page and why

steps.title: A cold New Tab before any extension (warms the spare pool)
A workspace whose terminal writes the extension
Save the one-line hello page as the customize app
cmux: clear; D="${CMUX_CUSTOMIZE_DIR:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/cmux/customize}"; mkdir -p "$D"; printf '%s\n' 'globalThis.__cmuxAppExports = { renderNewTab: () => VStack([Text("hello")]) }' > "$D/main.js"; printf '%s\n' '{"manifestVersion": 2, "id": "local/customize", "name": "Hello", "version": "1.0.0", "description": "One line on every new tab.", "engines": {"cmux": "^2.0"}, "runtime": {"main": "main.js"}, "implements": {"cmux.newtab/1": {"export": "renderNewTab", "title": "Hello", "symbol": "clock"}}}' > "$D/cmux-app.json"; echo saved hello

steps.title: Save the clock sample (examples/extensions/newtab-clock) as the customize app
cmux: clear; export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"; bun {repo}/cmux-tui/crates/cmux-app-host/tools/pack.ts {repo}/examples/extensions/newtab-clock >/dev/null && cp {repo}/examples/extensions/newtab-clock/dist/main.js "$D/main.js" && sed -e 's#"local/showcase-[a-z-]*"#"local/customize"#' -e 's#"dist/main.js"#"main.js"#' -e 's#"dist/"#"main.js"#' {repo}/examples/extensions/newtab-clock/cmux-app.json > "$D/cmux-app.json" && echo saved clock

steps.title: Back to the workspace with tabs
New Tab 4: the clock, a second later
Save a page whose render throws
cmux: clear; printf '%s\n' 'globalThis.__cmuxAppExports = { renderNewTab: () => { throw new Error("clock broke") } }' > "$D/main.js"; echo saved broken
